title: Kohestak, Sirik in Mourning for Wedding Victims; 4-Year-Old Amir Mohammad Held Close by Grieving Community.
text:
Kohestak, Sirik in Mourning for Wedding Victims; 4-Year-Old Amir Mohammad Held Close by Grieving Community."

" The residents of Kohestak-e Sirik are observing mourning for the martyrs of the wedding ceremony, where the anguish of 4-year-old Amir Mohammad has been taken into the embrace of the people.
